_doc: [ui2] Workbench tabs appear only once they are open (the owner: don't show what you can't use yet). A tab opens when ANY of its conditions holds, and stays open for good (flags.bench_tabs). Conditions: ["earned", N] lifetime cubes earned; ["stat", key, N] GameState.stats[key] >= N; ["hub_level", N]; ["flag", key]; ["always"]; ["builds"] something to build or built (HubBuilds, [ui3]). rockets is not a tab any more: it sets when the Upgrades tab shows its Rocket section. Other systems can add a gate in code: UpgradesScreen.set_tab_gate(id, func() -> bool, hint), which wins over this table. [v1guide] ["bench_tier", N] the workbench's tier; ["tower", N] the signal tower's tier. Owner 2026-11-08: tabs past Upgrades and Build open only by upgrading the workbench (tiers, ui/bench_tiers.gd): each tier lists the tabs it opens, its cost and what it waits for (requires: conditions, all must hold). grants: currencies the tier brings ([v6pace] the Bot Bay's robot kit: Parts for the first Scoopie, so the first robot never waits on lucky salvage). grants_research: research the tier brings with it (the Bot Bay comes with Salvage Logic, so its first robot can be built before the Research tab opens). upgrade_order: the fixed order of the Upgrades tab's Lumi and machine rows (owner: rows never move by price); ids not listed follow in data/upgrades.json order.

tiers.name: Workbench
tiers.desc: The repaired bench: upgrades for Lumi and things to build.

tiers.name: Workbench Mk II: Bot Bay
tiers.desc: Adds a bot bay. Build helpers that keep cleaning while you work.

tiers.name: Workbench Mk III: Research Desk
tiers.desc: Adds a research desk. Study what you dig up to unlock machines and seeds.

tiers.name: Workbench Mk IV: Request Board
tiers.desc: Adds a request board. Take on jobs for tokens and rare parts.
